subject: The secret I wasn't going to send expires tomorrow
preview_text: I set something aside for you when you joined 30 days ago. It disappears at midnight.
body_paragraphs: I have a confession. When you downloaded PupShape 30 days ago, I did something I've never told anyone. I flagged your account. I set something aside for you, just in case you were one of the few who stuck with it. The ones who actually care about doing right by their dog.

Tomorrow marks 30 days. And the thing I set aside for you—a complete, unlocked PupShape plan—expires. It's not a discount. It's the whole thing. Vet-approved meal plans, the calorie calculator, the progress tracker, the exercise guides, the photo timeline. All of it. I only did this for the people who joined that week. It was a test. To see who was serious.

If you open the app right now, you'll see it. There's a banner at the top of your home screen. 'Your 30-Day Access.' Tap it. It shows you what your dog's next 8 weeks could look like, completely unlocked. No restrictions. You can see the full custom meal plan I built for your specific dog, based on the info you gave me.

Tap that banner before midnight tomorrow. See the full plan. If it makes sense, keep it. If not, no hard feelings. But look at it. For your dog. P.S. The 110+ dogs on healthier paths? Every single one of their owners saw this same screen. They all had the same 24-hour window. This is yours.
Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan
